name: Homes
summary: Lets each player save named home locations and teleport to them with /trigger commands. By default each player may set one home.

mechanics.title: Home IDs
mechanics.description: Homes are numbered. Plain /trigger sethome is home 1; /trigger sethome set 2 is home 2, and so on. You can only add a new ID while under the maximum home limit (default 1 home per player; operators can raise it, and a per-player override exists via the homes.limit scoreboard). Setting an existing ID overwrites that home. If you exceed the limit: 'You can only set a maximum of N home(s).'

mechanics.title: Naming homes
mechanics.description: Hold a name tag that already has a custom name (rename it in an anvil) in your main hand and run /trigger namehome (or /trigger namehome set <ID>). Holding an unnamed name tag resets the home to its default name. Without a name tag you get an error.

mechanics.title: Teleporting
mechanics.description: /trigger home (or /trigger home set <ID>) teleports you to that home, across dimensions. Defaults: 0 tick delay and 0 second cooldown; with a delay you must stand still ('You must stand still to teleport.'). Your previous position is saved for /trigger back.

mechanics.title: Listing and deleting
mechanics.description: /trigger homes lists your homes ('You are homeless.' if none). /trigger delhome (or /trigger delhome set <ID>) deletes one.

commands_and_keybinds: /trigger namehome  and  /trigger namehome set <ID>  (hold a renamed name tag in main hand)
/function homes:config : (operators) Max Home Limit (default 1), Delay in ticks (default 0), Cooldown in seconds (default 0)
getting_started: Stand at your base and type /trigger sethome. Return any time with /trigger home.
editor_notes: Default limit is 1; no pack config in the repo raises it, so a server operator would need to run /scoreboard players set #limit homes.config <n> if more homes are wanted.
